title: DRAM RAPL reads zero with Mode 1 selected
description: MSR 619 and 618 read 0 and Linux exposes no DRAM RAPL subdomain, although every saved IntelSetup record in the 6 November dump has DRAM RAPL Baseline 1299=2 (Mode 1).
not_established: Mode 1 needs a measurement source the board may lack.
remediation: None yet. Test Mode 0 before any code change, C3.
